stories.story_fr: Vonovia progresse vers ses objectifs de croissance 2028, visant 20 a 25% de son resultat issu d'activites non-locatives (developpement, services), diversifiant son modele au-dela du loyer pur.
stories.story_en: Vonovia advances toward its 2028 growth objectives, targeting 20 to 25% of its result from non-rental activities (development, services), diversifying beyond pure rental income.
stories.quote: 20-25% are expected to come from non-rental activities

stories.story_fr: Vonovia maintient un fort pipeline de construction avec plus de 4 200 logements en cours et environ 65 000 unites a long terme, soutenant la croissance future des loyers organiques.
stories.story_en: Vonovia maintains a strong construction pipeline with more than 4,200 units underway and around 65,000 units long-term, supporting future organic rent growth.
stories.quote: undertaking construction projects for more than 4,200 units. The long-term pipeline comprises around 65,000 units
